jordana: Quick design thread — spending page toggles & invoice CTA placement. Want to lock this before devs start. alex: Figma draft: https://www.figma.com/file/XXX — two patterns: 1) header toolbar toggle (Org / Project) + header-level invoice CTA, 2) scope chip in left rail + per-row download actions. Also a compact vs dense row layout for project lists. pm_liu: Context: enterprise customers look for a single "Download invoice" at account-level. Smaller teams expect per-project invoices. We need discoverability without clutter. :thinking: maria: Implementation note: header toolbar toggle is simpler to route. Per-row download requires extra API calls to fetch invoice metadata for each project row — perf cost. sam: We can lazy-load invoice links for visible rows only and cache. Alternative: header CTA when Org selected, per-row links only for Project scope. ella: Accessibility nit: current mock uses label "Org / Project" which isn't descriptive for screen readers. Need aria text that communicates both the control purpose and current selection. alex: Suggestion for aria: ```
``` jordana: Copy debate: "Download invoice" vs "Download billing statement" vs "Export invoice" — legal says use "Invoice". Any objections? :eyes: pm_liu: Keep "Invoice" to align with contracts. We can surface secondary microcopy like "CSV available" for exports. alex: Layout proposal: show a prominent Org summary card with totals + big "Download invoice" CTA when Org is selected; when Project is selected collapse summary and show compact project rows with inline export icon. maria: Agree, but on mobile the summary card collapses — we need the header CTA to persist (sticky) so users can still download. jordana: Decision checklist: Alex updates Figma to show header toggle + org summary card + header CTA. Maria to identify API endpoints impacted. Ella to add aria labels and keyboard flow. Sam, estimate dev effort? sam: Frontend ~3d to implement header toggle + summary card + keyboard nav, backend ~1d to add simple caching/lazy invoice endpoint. Can PR after Figma update. :white_check_mark: deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created task #4521 for invoice endpoint caching. jordana: Thanks team — I'll post updated Figma and mark this thread design-ready. :tada:
